tool_args.rationale: The six observations leave genuine ambiguity in the coupled substrate–gradient response, particularly its behavior away from the observed combinations. The trajectory batch can provide additional variation before committing to a model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All six observations are below its stated critical-gradient range, so they cannot identify the avalanche term; other sink mechanisms remain plausible.
The observations vary substrate and gradient together, leaving the substrate response and sink interaction insufficiently distinguished.
The open-branch observation has already been acquired; a broader batch is more informative for the remaining ambiguity.
